newsitem.title: USA: Fibreboard sees profit gain on acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Fibreboard sees profit gain on acquisition.

text.p: Fibreboard Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to purchase Fabwel Inc for about $120 million, adding the acquisition is expected to contribute $0.20-$0.30 per share for the remainder of 1997.
Fibreboard said the expected incremental contribution of this acquisition on an annualized basis is $0.30-$0.40 per share.

Privately-held Fabwel, headquartered in Elkhart, Ind., is a major producer and supplier of customized exterior components for the manufactured housing, recreational vehicle, building and construction, and transportation/cargo industries with annual revenues of approximately $200 million.

"The substantial addition of Fabwel increases the size of Fibreboard's annual revenues by approximately 40 percent. Additionally, Fabwel provides aggressive growth in niche segments of our core industry and has the opportunity to flourish as part of the Fibreboard family of building products businesses," chief executive John D. Roach said.
The transaction is subject to due diligence and regulatory approval and is expected to close in the second quarter of 1997, Fibreboard said.
